notes: 9.9.6 The above tabie provides the information regarding the quantity of the various drugs that were seized
in the searches conducted by the various enforcement agencies. The quantity wise analysis of the drugs that
were seized indicates that during 1997 Ganja, Cocaine, Opium and Morphine recorded significant increase in
Transportation. From 62,992 kgs in 1996, Ganja seizures increased to 76,336 Kys in 1997 and
Cocaine seizures increased from 3 Kgs. to 24 Kgs.. The year 1997 experienced drop in the trafficking of
